questions.question: What is the PC 200 salary indexation on 1 January 2026?

mitosis.answer:
PC 200 indexation on 1 January 2026 is 2.21%, applied to actual salaries and minimum scales [be_fr_pc200_index_2026][slk_2025_12_22_final][tkt_2026_0019_mertens].

Forecast vs final: the 2.13% was an October 2025 Pro-Pay forecast. The final 2.21% wins, per policy PAY-IDX-01 v2 (final figures only) [be_fr_pc200_index_2026][tkt_2025_0870_vandessel].

Per-client differences:
- Van Dessel: the 2019 company CAO moves the index to 1 February 2026. It applies only to gross base salary and excludes the 145 euro brouwerijpremie, which gets a fixed 2% on 1 July. January is paid without indexation, except where pay falls below the indexed sector minimum, which then applies from 1 January [cao_vandessel_2019][eml_vandessel_budget]. Slack says Van Dessel "got 2.21 like everyone", but that reflects an engine error (the CAO flag was lost in migration). The CAO and ticket win. January is to be recalculated, with the correction planned in the February run [tkt_2026_0015_vandessel][slk_2026_01_09_vandessel].
- Delta: payslips showed 2.13% because of a manual override (IDX_PC200_2026 = 2.13) that the central update does not overwrite. The fix is to remove the override and pay the 0.08 point difference retroactively. Client approval was still pending, and the draft reply (not sent) mentions February [tkt_2026_0012_delta][eml_delta_complaint].
- Mertens: no override, calculated at 2.21% [tkt_2026_0019_mertens].
- Other PC 200 clients: 1 January, 2.21%.

Other committees: 2.21% does not apply to them. PC 124 gets the quarterly step of 0.21859% and PC 330 gets 2%. The Slack "across the board" claim is wrong, because the ticket, config and email outrank chat [tkt_2026_0021_maes][tkt_2026_0024_az][slk_2026_01_06_pc124].

questions.question: The final index is not published yet at the January payroll cut-off. Can we apply the forecast?

mitosis.answer:
No, don't apply the forecast. Policy PAY-IDX-01 v2 (valid from 3 Nov 2025) forbids applying any forecast, even temporarily [pol_index_v2]. The newsletter also says not to load forecast figures as final [int_outlook_2025_11].

What to do:
- The January cut-off is 27 December [pol_index_v2].
- If the final figure is still missing then, run January payroll without the indexation and apply it retroactively in February [pol_index_v2].

Where sources disagree:
- Policy: v1 allowed forecasts and set the cut-off at 20 December [pol_index_v1]. v2 wins because it is newer and explicitly replaces v1.
- PC 200 figure: Pro-Pay forecast 2.13% [be_propay_forecast_pc200] and our model ~2.2% [int_outlook_2025_11], versus the final 2.21% [int_index_calendar_2026]. The final wins because it is Agoria's official figure (22 Dec 2025) and the forecasts predate the December health index.

Per-scope differences:
- Client CAOs that deviate from the sector rule take precedence for that client [pol_index_v2]. For example, Brouwerij Van Dessel indexes on 1 February instead of 1 January. Other PC 200 clients keep 1 January [int_index_calendar_2026].
- Other joint committees have their own figures, so don't copy the PC 200 figure across. PC 302 (horeca) is 2.189%, not the ~2.1% forecast.
- The centenindex note covers the 1 July 2026 step and gives no forecast rule [int_centenindex_note_2026].

mitosis.answer:
The PC 200 indexation on 1 January 2026 is 2.21%. This is the final figure.

Scope of application: Agoria confirms 2.21% for effectively paid salaries, sectoral minimum scales and the guaranteed minimum monthly income. The standard rules apply, because the regulatory framework for a modified mechanism was not ready in time [be_agoria_pc200_index_2026].

Calculation: Acerta uses the smoothed health index: (133.07 + 133.33) / (130.22 + 130.42) = +2.21% [be_acerta_pc200_index_2026]. Securex, SD Worx and Orbiss report the same figure [be_securex_pc200_index_2026][be_sdworx_press_pc200_221][be_orbiss_pc200_221].

Where sources differ:
- Pro-Pay's October 2025 forecast: 2.13%. It was explicitly only a forecast, since the November and December health index figures were not yet known [be_propay_forecast_pc200].
- Final figure: 2.21%.
- Which wins: 2.21%, because the official communiqué supersedes the forecast. Securex says any provisional figure should be corrected to it. Agent A12 could not check the communiqué directly and relied on the scope's conflict note, but the sector and payroll sources independently agree with it.

Caution: 2.21% is specific to PC 200. Do not copy it to other joint committees [be_sdworx_press_pc200_221].
